post.title: SOLIDWORKS wants $235 a month. AnvilCAD is free.
post.caption: Two fresh grudges: a CAD app for anyone tired of SOLIDWORKS' bill and its crashes, and a budget app that doesn't charge you to see your budget.

segments.quote: I hate how expensive it is, especially for 10-year-old bugs to still exist.

cues.say: SolidWorks wants two hundred thirty-five dollars a month
[sarcastic] I hate how expensive it is,

cues.cap: especially for 10-year-old bugs to still exist.”
cues.say: especially for ten-year-old bugs to still exist.

cues.cap: So: AnvilCAD. Rust, feature trees, no licence server.
cues.say: [quick] So: Anvil CAD. Rust, feature trees, no licence server.

segments.gripe: Budget apps charge you to see you're broke.
segments.quote: free but charge money for important features or charge money to be used at all.
